scientific_integrity.asserted_domain: All finite loopless directed multiquivers over finite fields of positive characteristic, all integer restricted heights at least one; reduced geometric locus over algebraically closed fields.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Vertex-idempotent normalization, central scalar quotient, Frobenius-root normalization, Jordan centralizer enumeration, nilpotent orbit dominance.

scientific_limitations: Loopless quivers only, though directed cycles and parallel arrows are allowed.
Finite-field counts concern outer derivation cohomology classes, not all derivations or automorphism-conjugacy orbits.
Normalization uses perfect fields; the geometric assertions describe reduced loci and do not assert an isomorphism of parameter varieties.
The general conclusions rest on a mathematical proof, with finite computations serving as checks, not an infinite certificate.
Publication priority and independent audit remain unresolved.
title: Restricted nilpotent cones of loopless radical-square-zero quiver algebras
